title: Symrise inaugurates new Grasse site for natural fragrance ingredients
summary: Symrise has inaugurated a new production site for its natural fragrance ingredients brand Lautier 1795 in the Grasse region. This strengthens its capabilities in southern France jointly with the recently acquired premium natural qualities of Floral Concept. The new site forms an integral part of the Symrise fragrance ecosystem in southern France jointly with the premium naturals' expertise of Floral Concept and SFA Neroli's creative capabilities.
